sentences: One cockpit door opened, and a flight had a chance to survive.
On September thirtieth, twenty twenty-six, flydubai flight F Z ten seventy-three was heading from Dubai to Tel Aviv.
UAE investigators say the co-pilot attacked the captain with a crash axe and tried to take control.
The aircraft descended sharply. Passengers first thought they were facing severe turbulence.
But the wounded captain managed to open the cockpit door, according to Reuters reporting.
Passengers and crew intervened and subdued the attacker.
Reserve pilots travelling on board took control and brought the aircraft to Tabuk, Saudi Arabia.
It landed safely. Flydubai said all passengers and crew were accounted for.
Authorities described an attempted terrorist attack. Their investigation remains ongoing.
The rescue involved the captain, the people who intervened, and the pilots who landed the plane.
